properties.name: agentmesh.metrics-logger.reportPeriodSeconds
properties.description: The interval (in seconds) at which the metrics will be reported into the log stream by the metrics-logger.

properties.name: agentmesh.tasks.http.readTimeout
properties.description: The read timeout of the underlying HttpClient used by the HTTP task.

properties.name: agentmesh.tasks.http.connectTimeout
properties.description: The connection timeout of the underlying HttpClient used by the HTTP task.

properties.name: agentmesh.tasks.kafka-publish.requestTimeoutMs
properties.description: The request.timeout.ms value that the kafka producer is configured with in the KAFKA_PUBLISH task.

properties.name: agentmesh.tasks.kafka-publish.maxBlockMs
properties.description: The max.block.ms value that the kafka producer is configured with in the KAFKA_PUBLISH task.

properties.name: agentmesh.tasks.kafka-publish.cacheSize
properties.description: The maximum number of entries permitted in the in-memory cache used by the KAFKA_PUBLISH task.

properties.name: agentmesh.tasks.kafka-publish.cacheTimeMs
properties.description: The duration after which a cached entry will be removed from the in-memory cache used by the KAFKA_PUBLISH task.

properties.name: agentmesh.workflow-status-listener.type
properties.description: The implementation of the workflow status listener to be used.

properties.name: agentmesh.workflow-execution-lock.type
properties.description: The implementation of the workflow execution lock to be used.

properties.name: agentmesh.event-queues.sqs.enabled
properties.description: Enable the use of AWS SQS implementation to provide queues for consuming events.

properties.name: agentmesh.event-queues.amqp.enabled
properties.description: Enable the use of RabbitMQ implementation to provide queues for consuming events.

properties.name: agentmesh.event-queues.nats.enabled
properties.description: Enable the use of NATS implementation to provide queues for consuming events.

properties.name: agentmesh.event-queues.nats-stream.enabled
properties.description: Enable the use of NATS Streaming implementation to provide queues for consuming events.

properties.name: agentmesh.event-queues.kafka.enabled
properties.description: Enable the use of Kafka implementation to provide queues for consuming events.

properties.name: agentmesh.default-event-queue.type
properties.description: The default event queue type to listen on for the WAIT task.

properties.name: agentmesh.workflow-status-listener.composite.types
properties.description: List of workflow listener types to enable when using composite listener. Valid values: workflow_publisher, queue_publisher, kafka, archive

values.description: Use the no-op implementation of the workflow status listener.
Use then archive implementation which immediately archives the workflow upon termination or completion as the workflow status listener.
Use the publisher implementation which publishes a message to the underlying queue implementation upon termination or completion as the workflow status listener.

Use this publisher to publish workflow status changed to Kafka. The events published are the following Termination, Completion, Finalization, Started, Rearan, Retried, Paused, Resumed, Restarted, Finalized.
Use the composite implementation to enable multiple workflow status listeners simultaneously. Configure the listeners to enable using agentmesh.workflow-status-listener.composite.types property.
Use AWS SQS as the event queue to listen on for the WAIT task.
Use RabbitMQ as the event queue to listen on for the WAIT task.
Use NATS Stream as the event queue to listen on for the WAIT task.
Use Kafka as the event queue to listen on for the WAIT task.
Use the no-op implementation as the lock provider.
Use the local in-memory cache based implementation as the lock provider.
Use the redis-lock implementation as the lock provider.
Use the zookeeper-lock implementation as the lock provider.
